title: Opening night report: Electra/Persona — 6 reviews live, composite 68
description:
ELECTRA / PERSONA — National Theatre (Lyttelton), West End. Press night 2026-09-01.
PARITY REACHED 2026-09-02T02:28Z.

FINAL COUNT: 6 reviews live on prod. Composite score 68.01 (visible). Breakdown 4 positive / 1 mixed / 1 negative.
  The Guardian — Arifa Akbar — 60 (T1, 2026-09-01)
  BroadwayWorld — Clementine Scott — 79 (2026-09-02)
  Daily Mail — Patrick Marmion — 49 (2026-09-02)
  Timboatswain — Tim Boatswain — 95 (T3, 2026-08-23)
  Boycotting Trends — Alex Ramon — 79 (T3, 2026-08-31)
  Monstagigz — 77 (T3, 2026-08-23)

PARITY: census union == data/reviews.json (6) == prod shows JSON (6). No orphans in either direction.

TIMELINE (25 monitor passes, 2026-09-01 16:45Z to 2026-09-02 02:38Z):
  16:45Z  baseline: 2 T3 blogs live, no press reviews. Embargo not lifted.
  19:24Z  first census change in 7 passes: Boycotting Trends found.
  19:28Z  ingested; 20:23Z scored; 21:12Z live on prod. firstSeen->live = 108 min.
  ~00:30Z Guardian (Akbar) — first T1 — plus Daily Mail and BroadwayWorld enter the pipeline.
  02:05Z  reviews.json 6, prod 4 — deploy lag on Daily Mail + BroadwayWorld, composite still null.
  02:28Z  deploy landed: prod 6, composite 68.01 appears. PARITY.

FIXES APPLIED THIS NIGHT (with failure-mode class):
  1. Boycotting Trends (blogspot) — class 3d, missed discovery: domain had zero entries in outlet-registry.json and zero events in stage-latency.jsonl, so discovery never saw it. Fixed by adding the registry entry to BOTH the web repo and the core-data repo (75fb0f4d1) and direct-URL ingesting the review (9f12ab18e0c). Live on prod.
  2. Includable-but-unscored stall — the recovered review sat out of reviews.json for ~90 min because rebuild only emits SCORED reviews and the scorer had not yet run. Diagnosed via verify-review-recovery.js. Resolved by the pipeline itself once ensemble scoring ran; no intervention needed. Worth knowing: this looks exactly like a broken rebuild and is not one.
  3. Cultural Capital (maryamphilpottblog.wordpress.com) — same missed-discovery class, registry entry added, but ingest fails deterministically at fetchPage(): the Playwright path waits for networkidle, which never settles on wordpress.com. Carded BRO-2729, parked (shared scraper infra, not safe to edit during an opening-night window). This is the ONE published review not live. T3 blog, cosmetic against a 6-review corpus.
  4. _pending no-byline strand drained (empty and holding since 20:55Z). Carded BRO-2735.

STILL OUTSTANDING (not gaps — nothing published to miss):
  The main UK press pack has not filed at 03:33 BST, ~6.5h past a normal embargo lift: Times, Telegraph, Evening Standard, Independent, FT, Observer, WhatsOnStage, The Stage, TimeOut. Verified this pass by direct section-page fetch on all six reachable sources plus WebSearch, not by SERP alone. Likely holding for weekend editions. The monitor keeps running to 2026-09-02T22:59Z and will ingest them when they land.

WORKFLOWS DISPATCHED: none. Zero force-dispatches across all 25 passes — the automated orchestrator/poller chain fired on its own every time. Zero gh waits started.

BROADCAST GATE: NOT MET (6 scored, needs 8+). Verified and logged only. Nothing sent.

NEW FAILURE MODES CARDED: BRO-2729 (fetchPage Playwright networkidle hang on wordpress.com), BRO-2732 (rebuild-reviews.yml push failure — real but NOT the blocker here), BRO-2735 (_pending strand).

SPEND: ~$1.20 across 25 passes.

title: Opening night report: Electra / Persona - 15 reviews live, CS 67.54
description:
OPENING NIGHT REPORT - Electra / Persona (National Theatre, Lyttelton), West End. PARITY REACHED.

FINAL STATE (verified on prod 2026-09-02T12:21:05.279Z): 15 reviews live, Critic Score 67.54, status open, all 15 scored.

PER-OUTLET (outlet / critic / score): Time Out London Andrzej Lukowski 80 | The Independent Unknown 62 | The Guardian Arifa Akbar 60 | The Times (UK) Clive Davis, Chief Theatre Critic 60 | The Stage Holly O'Mahony 56 | Daily Mail Patrick Marmion 49 | BroadwayWorld Clementine Scott 79 | WhatsOnStage Alex Wood 78 | London Theatre Unknown 62 | Timboatswain Tim Boatswain 95 | All That Dazzles  (UK) All That Dazzles 86 | Boycotting Trends Alex Ramon 79 | Monstagigz Unknown 77 | Sunday Telegraph Claire Allfree 69 | Cultural Capital Unknown 64.

VERIFIED EXCLUSIONS (sampled, confirmed non-reviewers): Evening Standard, Financial Times, Variety, The Arts Desk, The Reviews Hub, Everything Theatre, iNews, LondonTheatre1, Musical Theatre Review. Broadway Baby appeared to hit but resolved to a different Edinburgh Fringe show also titled 'Persona' (zero Lyttelton/Blanchett references). Decoys correctly excluded from the score: WhatsOnStage casting news, Variety cast interview, TimeOut/Southbank/TheatreMonkey/TheatreWorkout listings, London Box Office (aggregator), TheatreBoard forum thread, a Natalie Haynes Guardian opinion column published 3 days before previews. One true blind spot across all 49 passes: telegraph.co.uk/theatre returns a 1030-byte JS shell to every fetch path tried, so the daily Telegraph was never sampled; Sunday Telegraph (Claire Allfree) is live at 69, so the risk is low.

TIMELINE. First review seen 2026-08-23 (two pre-opening T3 blogs; rebuilt to count 1 on 08-29 05:47Z). Press night 2026-09-01, but the UK embargo did NOT lift that evening - 12 consecutive census sweeps through 22:15 BST found zero press reviews, correctly diagnosed as an empty press corpus rather than a pipeline failure. Embargo lifted overnight: count 2 -> 6 by 02:19Z, -> 14 by 10:31Z on 09-02, first parity 11:04Z after the 10:48Z deploy. The Independent then published LATE (06:52 EDT 09-02, after the census had been declared exhausted); found by curl sweep at 11:33Z, ingested, scored 62, rebuilt into reviews.json at 12:10:57Z and live on prod shortly after. Roughly 2 hours from the bulk of the press drop to full live coverage - inside the mission bar.

FIXES BY FAILURE-MODE CLASS. (1) Missed discovery (3d) - Boycotting Trends (blogspot) and Cultural Capital (wordpress.com) were absent from outlet-registry.json so discovery never saw them; registry entries added and pushed to both repos, Boycotting Trends direct-URL ingested. Both live (79, 64). (2) Content-fetch failure - All That Dazzles landed as a zero-char stub; re-ingested and live. The pipeline deduped its own second copy correctly. (3) Includable-but-unscored, a genuinely new mode - a recovered review passed every exclusion check but had no llmScore, and since the rebuild only emits scored reviews the count stayed flat and looked like a push failure. A stuck review count does not imply a broken rebuild. (4) Self-resolved - The Stage briefly displayed critic 'Unknown' while a byline'd copy sat on disk; a later rebuild preferred the byline'd file on its own. (5) LATE missed discovery (3d, new tonight) - The Independent / Alice Saville published the MORNING AFTER press night, hours after the census looked settled at 14 and after 'census exhausted' had been recorded. Found only because a later pass re-swept the T1 section pages anyway. Lesson for the monitor: never stop sweeping while the window is open.

OPERATIONAL NOTE. rebuild-fast.yml flapped all morning (10:55 failure, 11:06 success, 11:08 cancelled, 11:50 failure) yet the data still landed via a later run. A rebuild-fast 'failure' conclusion is not proof the data did not land - check the core-data repo's git log for reviews.json instead.

WORKFLOWS DISPATCHED: none forced. The automated chain carried the entire press drop unaided; every intervention was data-layer only.

CARDED (all parked, none blocking): BRO-2729 fetchPage Playwright path waits for networkidle, which never settles on wordpress.com, timeout.com and Wix sites. BRO-2732 rebuild-reviews.yml push failure (separate from, and not the cause of, the stuck count above). BRO-2735 _pending zero-text stubs can silently swallow reviews.

COVERAGE GAP SIGNAL: All That Dazzles and the Guardian review both reached prod with no review-first-seen event in stage-latency.jsonl, so their discovery-to-live latency is unmeasurable. The other outlets are fully instrumented.

BROADCAST GATE: MET (15 scored, threshold 8). Verified and logged only. Nothing sent.

SPEND: roughly $5 per pass across 49 launchd passes; this final pass about $0.20 (a dozen curl fetches, no scraper credits).

State file: data/opening-night-monitor/session-state-on-monitor-2026-09-01.json
